witness_semantics: witness/<aid>.py runs the artifact's solve.py, then independently checks: W2 AGGREGATE warehouse outbound capacity (sum over stores); W3 every store's demand met exactly; W4 non-negative shipments; W5 reported objective equals recomputed cost with TRUE route costs (tol 1e-6).

c5_scope.description: C5 quantifier-scope error: aggregate warehouse cap written per-route. Type-legal, looser, cheaper; true aggregate capacity violated.
